rule_text.name: 701.74a
rule_text.rule: To submerge a card, exile it face up, then put it onto the battlefield face down under its owner's control as a 2/2 face-down creature card with no text, no name, no subtypes, and no mana cost. That permanent is a submerged permanent as long as it remains face down. The effect defining its characteristics works while the card is face down and ends when it’s turned face up.

rule_text.name: 701.74b
rule_text.rule: Unlike manifest, a submerged card can not turn face up again on its own.
